# Load Data
```{r, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(mapcdatakeys)
library(data.table)
options('scipen' = 10)

data_path = "K:/DataServices/Projects/Current_Projects/Regional_Plan_Update_Research/Speculative Investment/Data/"
export_path = "K:/DataServices/Projects/Data_Requests/2026/WGBH_Neisloss"

setwd(data_path)

#starting from mapc filtered file
#warren <- read_csv("2000_2025_warren_speculative-investment-analysis-dataset_withforeclosure_5yr-window-networks.csv")

warren_nofd <- read_csv("2000_2025_warren_speculative-investment-analysis-dataset_withoutforeclosure_5yr-window-networks.csv")

warren_clean <- warren_nofd |> 
  #clean up issue of missing inv_type_purchase due to NAs
  mutate(
    #make NAs a string
    investor_type_purchase_value = ifelse(is.na(investor_type_purchase_value), "NA", investor_type_purchase_value),
    #redefine final investor category for cases where is is missing
    investor_type_purchase = ifelse(!is.na(investor_type_purchase), investor_type_purchase, 
                              ifelse((investor_type_purchase_value=='Institutional' | investor_type_purchase_count=='Institutional'),'Institutional',
                                ifelse((investor_type_purchase_value=='Large' | investor_type_purchase_count=='Large'), 'Large',
                                  ifelse((investor_type_purchase_value=='Medium'| investor_type_purchase_count=='Medium'), 'Medium',
                                   ifelse((investor_type_purchase_value=='Small'| investor_type_purchase_count=='Small' | investor_type_purchase_llc=='Small LLC' | investor_type_purchase_building=='Building Investor'),'Small', 'Non-investor')))))
  )

# rm(warren_nofd)
gc()
```

# Adding helpful fields
```{r}
crosswalk <- mapcdatakeys::all_muni_data_keys |> 
  select(muni_name, muni_id, cmtyp08, mapc)

warren_plus <- warren_clean |> 
  left_join(crosswalk, by = "muni_id") |> 
  #creating flags to count 2 and 3 family purchases
  mutate(
    r1f_flag = ifelse(restype == "R1F", 1, 0),
    r2f_flag = ifelse(restype == "R2F", 1, 0),
    r3f_flag = ifelse(restype == "R3F", 1, 0),
    r1f_inv_f = ifelse(restype == "R1F" & investor_type_purchase != "Non-investor", 1, 0),
    r2f_inv_f = ifelse(restype == "R2F" & investor_type_purchase != "Non-investor", 1, 0),
    r3f_inv_f = ifelse(restype == "R3F" & investor_type_purchase != "Non-investor", 1, 0)
  )

gateway_cities <- c("Attleboro", "Barnstable", "Brockton", "Chelsea", "Chicopee", "Everett", "Fall River", "Fitchburg", "Haverhill", "Holyoke", "Lawrence", "Leominster", "Lowell", "Lynn", "Malden", "Methuen", "New Bedford", "Peabody", "Pittsfield", "Quincy", "Revere", "Salem", "Springfield", "Taunton", "Westfield", "Worcester")

rg_ub_center<-crosswalk%>%filter(cmtyp08 == "Regional Urban Center" )%>%pull(muni_name)

# rm(warren_clean)
gc()
```

# Median 2 & 3 Family Prices by Investor Type

Key Finding: Non Investors tend to pay more than other investors but in recent years small and medium investors are paying about as much. Large and institutional investors stil have a median purchase price ~$200k less

Identify 5 Munis inside outside MAPC for comparisons
```{r}

med_table<-warren_plus%>%
  mutate(deedtype = ifelse(is.na(deedtype), 'UNKNOWN', deedtype)) %>% 
  filter(deedtype != 'FD')%>%
  filter(municipal %in% gateway_cities | municipal %in% rg_ub_center,
         restype %in% c("R2F", "R3F"),
         price_adj > 50000 & price_adj <100000000,
         )%>%
  group_by(year, investor_type_purchase, restype)%>%
  summarize(median_adj = median(price_adj, na.rm =T))%>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(year, restype), names_from = investor_type_purchase, values_from = median_adj)%>%
  relocate(Small, .before = `Non-investor`)


write.csv(med_table, file.path(export_path, "2&3 Familiy Gateway+ Median Adjusted Price.csv"))

med_table_comp<-warren_plus%>%
  mutate(deedtype = ifelse(is.na(deedtype), 'UNKNOWN', deedtype)) %>% 
  filter(deedtype != 'FD')%>%
  filter(!municipal %in% c(gateway_cities, rg_ub_center),
         restype %in% c("R2F", "R3F"),
         price_adj > 50000 & price_adj <100000000,
         )%>%
  group_by(year, investor_type_purchase, restype)%>%
  summarize(median_adj = median(price_adj, na.rm =T))%>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(year, restype), names_from = investor_type_purchase, values_from = median_adj)%>%
  relocate(Small, .before = `Non-investor`)


write.csv(med_table_comp, file.path(export_path, "2&3 Family NonGateway+ Median Adjusted Price.csv") )

```

# Top Gateway Cities Investors
### Two and Three Family Investors
```{r}
## Identify the two/three family investors by count of total purchases of two and three family restypes, filtering out Foreclosures and banks
top_inv_23f <- warren_plus |> 
  #filtering to gateway cities and mapc regional urban centers
  filter(municipal %in% gateway_cities | municipal %in% rg_ub_center_mapc) |> 
  mutate(deedtype = ifelse(is.na(deedtype), 'UNKNOWN', deedtype)) %>% 
  filter(deedtype != 'FD')%>%
  #filter to 2-3 families
  filter(restype %in% c("R2F", "R3F")) |> 
  filter(!buyer1_adj %in% c("USA HUD", "FEDERAL NATIONAL MORTGAGE ASSOCIATION FANNIE MAE"),
          buyer_bnk_ind ==0)|>
  group_by(final_name, buyer1_adj) |> 
  summarize(total_gateway_purchases = n(),
            earliest_gateway_year = min(year),
            most_recent_gateway_year = max(year),
            cash_buys_gateways = sum(cash_sale, na.rm = T),
            median_price_gateways = median(price_adj, na.rm = T),
            total_spent_gateways = sum(price_adj, na.rm = T),
            flip_count_gateways  = sum(flip_ind, na.rm = T),
            inv_to_inv_gateways = sum(inv_to_inv, na.rm = T),
            selle_gateways = toString(unique(seller1_adj)),
            seller_inv_type_gateways = toString(unique(investor_type_sale))) |>
  arrange(desc(total_gateway_purchases))

lt<-NULL
lt[["top20_2_3"]] <- top_inv_23f |> 
  ungroup()%>%
  slice(0:20)%>%
  mutate(top_20 = "All Time")

lt[["to20_2_3_pst2020"]]<-top_inv_23f|>
  ungroup()%>%
  filter(most_recent_gateway_year>2019)%>%
  slice(0:20)%>%
  mutate(top_20 = "2020-2025")

lt[["top_20_2-3c_post_2015"]]<-top_inv_23f|>
  ungroup()%>%
  filter(most_recent_gateway_year>2014)%>%
  slice(0:20)%>%
  mutate(top_20 = "2015-2025")


all_top_20_23f<-rbindlist(lt)

## Calcualte Stats for the Networks the top buyers are in
network_total_purchase<-warren_plus%>%
  filter(final_name %in% all_top_20_23f$final_name)%>%
  group_by(final_name)%>%
  summarize(total_statewide_purchases = n(),
            total_flips = sum(flip_ind, na.rm = T),
            total_cash_buys = sum(cash_sale, na.rm = T),
            investor_type = toString(unique(investor_type_purchase)),
            network_munis_active = toString(unique(municipal)),
            newtork_count_munis = length(unique(municipal)),
            network_earliest_year = min(year),
            network_latest_year = max(year))

# Identifying the LLC officers for the owner networks

top_20_23f_inv_network_owners <- right_join(owner_networks, all_top_20_23f, by = c("name" = "buyer1_adj", "network_group"= "final_name"))%>%
  #owner_networks %>% 
  #filter(network_group %in% top_20_23f$final_name)|>
  select(name, network_group, company_id, total_gateway_purchases, cash_buys_gateways, earliest_gateway_year, most_recent_gateway_year, top_20)%>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  left_join(., select(oc_officers, company_number, name, officer, position, address.in_full), by = "name")%>%
  arrange(network_group)%>%
  # filter(!is.na(company_id))%>%
  # filter(!is.na(total_purchases))%>%
  group_by(officer, name)%>%
  mutate(position = toString(unique(position)))%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  distinct()%>%
  full_join(., network_total_purchase, by = c("network_group" = "final_name"))%>%
  relocate(network_earliest_year, network_latest_year, .after=most_recent_gateway_year)%>%
  mutate(top_20 = toString(unique(top_20)), .by = name)%>%
  distinct()

## Investor Activity in Each Muni over Time
top_20_23f_by_muni_year<-warren_plus%>%
  filter(buyer1_adj %in% all_top_20_23f$buyer1_adj)%>%
  group_by(buyer1_adj, municipal, year, restype)%>%
  summarize(total_purchases = n(),
            cash_buys = sum(cash_sale, na.rm = T),
            median_price = median(price_adj, na.rm = T),
            total_spent = sum(price_adj, na.rm = T),
            flip_count  = sum(flip_ind, na.rm = T),
            inv_to_inv = sum(inv_to_inv, na.rm = T),
            seller = toString(unique(seller1_adj)),
            seller_inv_type = toString(unique(investor_type_sale)),
            deedtypes = toString(unique(deedtype)))

# Purchase Level Data for investors 
address_tables<-NULL

for(buyer in unique(all_top_20_23f$buyer1_adj)){
  
  if(nchar(buyer)>30){
    buyer<-str_trunc(buyer, 30)
  }else{
    buyer<-buyer
  }
  
  address_tables[[buyer]]<-warren_plus%>%
    filter(buyer1_adj == buyer)%>%
    select(final_name, buyer1_adj, year, municipal, address, restype, current_owner)
  
}

openxlsx::write.xlsx(address_tables, file.path(export_path, "Top 20 Two-Three Family Investors Addresses.xlsx"), asTable = TRUE, overwrite = TRUE)
  
```  

### Non LLC Investors
```{r}
top_inv_non_llc <- warren_plus |> 
  #filtering to gateway cities and mapc regional urban centers
  filter(municipal %in% gateway_cities | municipal %in% rg_ub_center) |>
  filter(investor_type_purchase_llc == "Non-Small LLC", !str_detect(final_name, "HUD"), !str_detect(final_name,"cosine"), !str_detect(final_name, "network"), seller_bus_ind == 0)%>%
  mutate(deedtype = ifelse(is.na(deedtype), 'UNKNOWN', deedtype)) %>% 
  #filter(deedtype != 'FD')%>%
  filter(!deedtype %in% c('FD', 'RD'))%>%
  #filter to 2-3 families
  filter(restype %in% c("R2F", "R3F")) |> 
  group_by(final_name, buyer1_adj) |>
  summarize(total_gateway_purchases = n(),
            earliest_gateway_year = min(year),
            most_recent_gateway_year = max(year),
            cash_buys_gateway = sum(cash_sale, na.rm = T),
            median_gateway_price = median(price_adj, na.rm = T),
            total_spent_gateway = sum(price_adj, na.rm = T),
            flip_count_gateway  = sum(flip_ind, na.rm = T),
            inv_to_inv_gateway = sum(inv_to_inv, na.rm = T),
            seller_gateway = toString(unique(seller1_adj)),
            seller_inv_type_gateway = toString(unique(investor_type_sale)))|>
  arrange(desc(total_gateway_purchases))

lt<-NULL
lt[["top_10_non_llc"]] <- top_inv_non_llc |> 
  ungroup()%>%

  filter(most_recent_gateway_year>2019)%>%

lt[["top_10_non_llc_post_2015"]]<-top_inv_non_llc|>
  ungroup()%>%
  filter(most_recent_gateway_year>2014)%>%
  slice(0:10)%>%
  mutate(top_10 = "2015-2025")


all_top_ten_non_llc<-rbindlist(lt)



non_llc_total_purchase<-warren_plus%>%
  filter(final_name %in% all_top_ten_non_llc$final_name)%>%
  group_by(final_name)%>%
  summarize(total_statewide_purchases = n(),
            total_flips = sum(flip_ind, na.rm = T),
            total_cash_buys = sum(cash_sale, na.rm = T),
            investor_type = toString(unique(investor_type_purchase)),
            munis_active = toString(unique(municipal)),
            count_munis = length(unique(municipal)))%>%
  full_join(., all_top_ten_non_llc, by = "final_name")%>%
  relocate(total_gateway_purchases, .after = final_name )%>%
  mutate(top_10 = toString(unique(top_10)), .by = final_name)%>%
  distinct()

## Municipal and Year Stats for Investors 
top_10_non_llc_by_muni_year<-warren_plus%>%
  filter(buyer1_adj %in% top_10_non_llc$buyer1_adj)%>%

  summarize(total_purchases = n(),
            cash_buys = sum(cash_sale, na.rm = T),
            median_price = median(price_adj, na.rm = T),
            total_spent = sum(price_adj, na.rm = T),
            flip_count  = sum(flip_ind, na.rm = T),
            inv_to_inv = sum(inv_to_inv, na.rm = T),
            seller = toString(unique(seller1_adj)),
            seller_inv_type = toString(unique(investor_type_sale)),
            deedtypes = toString(unique(deedtype)))


## Purchase Level Data for Investors

for(buyer in unique(all_top_ten_non_llc$buyer1_adj)){
```

```{r}

#statewide
sales_p <- warren_plus |> 
  filter(price_adj>50, price_adj < 84000000)|>
  #count of all sales in the muni each year
  group_by(municipal, year) |> 
  mutate(tot_sales = n()) |> 
  group_by(municipal, year, investor_type_purchase, restype) |> 
  summarize(
    tot_sales = max(tot_sales),
    restype_sales = n(),
    r1f_count = sum(r1f_flag),
    r2f_count = sum(r2f_flag),
    r3f_count = sum(r3f_flag),
    r1f_inv = sum(r1f_inv_f),
    r2f_inv = sum(r2f_inv_f),
    r3f_inv = sum(r3f_inv_f),
    med_price_adj = median(price_adj)) |>
  ungroup()%>%
  rowwise()%>%
  mutate(sales_p = round(restype_sales/tot_sales, digits = 3))|>
  group_by(municipal,restype, investor_type_purchase)|>
  arrange(year)%>%
  mutate(
    r1f_inv_pch = (r1f_inv-lag(r1f_inv))/lag(r1f_inv),
         r2f_inv_pch = (r2f_inv-lag(r2f_inv))/lag(r2f_inv),
         r3f_inv_pch = (r3f_inv-lag(r3f_inv))/lag(r3f_inv))
```

## Identify investors
```{r}
investors <- warren_clean |> 
  #filter all transactions to given year and munis
  filter(year >= 2015) |>
  #select needed variables
  select(buyer1_adj, municipal, investor_type_purchase, investor_type_purchase_llc, investor_type_purchase_building, investor_type_purchase_count, investor_type_purchase_value, network_group) |> 
  #filter to only LLC investors
  filter(investor_type_purchase_llc == "Small LLC")

lynn_investors <- investors |> 
  filter(municipal == "Lynn") |> 
  #remove duplicates
  distinct() 
  
haverhill_investors <- investors |> 
  filter(municipal == "Haverhill") |> 
  #remove duplicates
  distinct() 
  
lowell_investors <- investors |> 
  filter(municipal == "Lowell") |> 
  #remove duplicates
  distinct() 
  
all_investors <- rbind(lynn_investors, haverhill_investors, lowell_investors)

#how many ownership networks do these investors really represent?
investors |> count(network_group)

setwd(export_path)
write.csv(lynn_investors, "lynn_investors.csv")
write.csv(haverhill_investors, "haverhill_investors.csv")
write.csv(lowell_investors, "lowell_investors.csv")

rm(investors, lynn_investors, haverhill_investors, lowell_investors)
gc()
```
1,654 unique LLC buyer names across 543 network groups
"all_investors" will include duplicates when investors have made purchases in more than one of the 3 included municipalities

## municipal purchases by investors
```{r}
warren_muni <- warren_clean |> 
  filter(municipal == "Lynn" | municipal == "Haverhill" | municipal == "Lowell") 

#count of purchases by investor by muni
inv_purchases <- warren_muni |> 
  select(buyer1_adj, network_group, municipal, year) |> 
  group_by(municipal) |> 
  #muni transaction count for full study period
  mutate(muni_00_25 = n(),
         inv_f_00_25 = ifelse(buyer1_adj %in% all_investors$buyer1_adj, 1, 0)) |> 
  filter(year >= 2015) |> 
  #muni transaction count 2015-2025
  mutate(muni_15_25 = n(),
         inv_f_15_25 = ifelse(buyer1_adj %in% all_investors$buyer1_adj, 1, 0)) |> 
  select(-c(year)) |> 
  group_by(municipal, buyer1_adj) |> 
  mutate(
    #count inv purchases in muni
    inv_pur_00_25 = sum(inv_f_00_25),
    #percent inv purchases in muni
    p_inv_00_25 = sum(inv_f_00_25)/muni_00_25,
    #count inv purchases in muni (2015-2025)
    inv_pur_15_25 = sum(inv_f_15_25),
    #percent inv purchases in muni (2015-2025)
    p_inv_15_25 = sum(inv_f_15_25)/muni_15_25,
  ) |> 
  select(-c(inv_f_00_25, inv_f_15_25))

#count of purchases by investor by muni
ntwk_purchases <- warren_muni |> 
  select(network_group, municipal, year) |> 
  group_by(municipal) |> 
  #muni transaction count for full study period
  mutate(muni_00_25 = n(),
         inv_f_00_25 = ifelse(network_group %in% all_investors$network_group, 1, 0)) |> 
  filter(year >= 2015) |> 
  #muni transaction count 2015-2025
  mutate(muni_15_25 = n(),
         inv_f_15_25 = ifelse(network_group %in% all_investors$network_group, 1, 0)) |> 
  select(-c(year)) |> 
  group_by(municipal, network_group) |> 
  mutate(
    #count inv purchases in muni
    inv_pur_00_25 = sum(inv_f_00_25),
    #percent inv purchases in muni
    p_inv_00_25 = sum(inv_f_00_25)/muni_00_25,
    #count inv purchases in muni (2015-2025)
    inv_pur_15_25 = sum(inv_f_15_25),
    #percent inv purchases in muni (2015-2025)
    p_inv_15_25 = sum(inv_f_15_25)/muni_15_25,
  ) |> 
  select(-c(inv_f_00_25, inv_f_15_25))
```

## 2 and 3 family trends
```{r}
#statewide
twof_threef <- warren_plus |> 
  group_by(#municipal, 
    year) |> 
  #create new indexes
  mutate(
  #large and institutional investors
  lrg_inst_r2f = ifelse((investor_type_purchase == "Large" | investor_type_purchase == "Institutional") & restype == "R2F", 1, 0),
  lrg_inst_r3f = ifelse((investor_type_purchase == "Large" | investor_type_purchase == "Institutional") & restype == "R3F", 1, 0),
  #llc/metacorp inv
  llc_net2 = ifelse((buyer_llc_ind == 1 | !is.na(network_group)) & restype == "R2F", 1, 0),
  llc_net3 = ifelse((buyer_llc_ind == 1 | !is.na(network_group)) & restype == "R3F", 1, 0)
  ) |> 
  #create summary table of variables to compare
  summarize(
    r2f_count = sum(r2f_flag),
    r3f_count = sum(r3f_flag),
    r2f_inv = sum(r2f_inv_f),
    r3f_inv = sum(r3f_inv_f),
    r2f_li_inv = sum(lrg_inst_r2f),
    r3f_li_inv = sum(lrg_inst_r3f),
    r2f_llc_net = sum(llc_net2),
    r3f_llc_net = sum(llc_net3)
  ) |> 
  arrange(#municipal, 
    year) |> 
  mutate(
    #rate of investor transactions
    r2f_inv_p = round(r2f_inv/r2f_count, digits = 2),
    r3f_inv_p = round(r3f_inv/r3f_count, digits = 2),
    #rate of large/inst inv transactions
    r2f_li_inv_p = round(r2f_li_inv/r2f_count, digits = 2),
    r3f_li_inv_p = round(r3f_li_inv/r3f_count, digits = 2),
    #rate of LLC/network buyers
    r2f_llc_net_p = round(r2f_llc_net/r2f_count, digits = 2),
    r3f_llc_net_p = round(r3f_llc_net/r3f_count, digits = 2),
    )
  
#cities of interest
twof_threef_gateway <- warren_plus |> 
  filter(municipal %in% gateway_cities | (cmtyp08 == "Regional Urban Center" & mapc == 1)) |> 
  #filter(year > 2010) |> 
  group_by(municipal, year) |> 
  #create new indexes
  mutate(
  #large and institutional investors
  lrg_inst_r2f = ifelse((investor_type_purchase == "Large" | investor_type_purchase == "Institutional") & restype == "R2F", 1, 0),
  lrg_inst_r3f = ifelse((investor_type_purchase == "Large" | investor_type_purchase == "Institutional") & restype == "R3F", 1, 0),
  #llc/metacorp inv
  llc_net2 = ifelse((buyer_llc_ind == 1 | !is.na(network_group)) & restype == "R2F", 1, 0),
  llc_net3 = ifelse((buyer_llc_ind == 1 | !is.na(network_group)) & restype == "R3F", 1, 0)
  ) |> 
  #create summary table of variables to compare
  summarize(
    r2f_count = sum(r2f_flag),
    r3f_count = sum(r3f_flag),
    r2f_inv = sum(r2f_inv_f),
    r3f_inv = sum(r3f_inv_f),
    r2f_li_inv = sum(lrg_inst_r2f),
    r3f_li_inv = sum(lrg_inst_r3f),
    r2f_llc_net = sum(llc_net2),
    r3f_llc_net = sum(llc_net3)
  ) |> 
  arrange(municipal, year) |> 
  mutate(
    #rate of investor transactions
    r2f_inv_p = round(r2f_inv/r2f_count, digits = 2),
    r3f_inv_p = round(r3f_inv/r3f_count, digits = 2),
    #rate of large/inst inv transactions
    r2f_li_inv_p = round(r2f_li_inv/r2f_count, digits = 2),
    r3f_li_inv_p = round(r3f_li_inv/r3f_count, digits = 2),
    #rate of LLC/network buyers
    r2f_llc_net_p = round(r2f_llc_net/r2f_count, digits = 2),
    r3f_llc_net_p = round(r3f_llc_net/r3f_count, digits = 2),
    ) |> 
  #filter to just years with at least 10 relevant sales
  filter(r2f_count + r3f_count >= 10) |> 
  group_by(municipal) |> 
  mutate(
    #count number of years each muni meets criteria for
    year_count = n()
  )
```
